Rule text: for a lot whose Chapter 900 exception is not authored, the route is undecided, not refused. The words "or a lot gate applies" in the not_permitted clause above mean a decided refusal; an unauthored exception is the gate of M-231 (Spec 134 section 5), which takes no winner on any target and writes not_evaluated:exception_not_authored on the lot.
